item.description: M365 Apps · Due in 7 days · deadline 2026-10-16

item.description: Entra · Due in 6 days · deadline 2026-10-15

item.description: Windows · Due in 4 days · deadline 2026-10-13

item.description: Windows Server · Due in 4 days · deadline 2026-10-13

item.description: Windows · Due in 4 days · deadline 2026-10-13

item.description: Windows · Due in 4 days · deadline 2026-10-13

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Windows Server 2012 and 2012 R2 ESU Year 3 ends
item.description: Windows Server · Due in 4 days · deadline 2026-10-13

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Windows Server 2022 moves to extended support
item.description: Windows Server · Due in 4 days · deadline 2026-10-13

item.title: [Due in 6 days] Autopatch gains separate control over quality updates, .NET Framework and quick machine recovery
item.description: Windows · Due in 6 days · deadline 2026-10-15

item.description: Exchange Online · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-10

item.title: [New] Microsoft's Graph permissions reference documents 33 more permissions, among them the thirteen that delete users' authentication methods, four identity-diagnostic names and four Customer Lockbox names
item.description: Graph · New

item.title: [New] Policy.ReadWrite.Recovery is now documented as an application permission too: the organization's recovery policy becomes writable without a signed-in user
item.description: Graph · New

item.title: [New] Microsoft now writes it down: an application with User.ReadWrite.All can update users who hold privileged admin roles
item.description: Graph · New

item.title: [New] MailboxItem.ImportExport and MailboxItem.ImportExport.All are relabelled from 'backup and restore' to 'export and import' of mailbox items
item.description: Graph · New

item.title: [New] Entra Kerberos gets one configuration guide: the key-rotation page is folded into it, with a stated rotation practice and a warning that only Set-AzureADKerberosServer may rotate the key
item.description: Entra · New

item.title: [New] Conditional Access baseline-scope enforcement: the page now speaks of the rollout in the past tense and adds a Graph query that lists the policies it affects
item.description: Entra · New

item.title: [New] RD Web Access stops rendering when browsers switch off XSLT; Microsoft publishes KB5130994 with workarounds
item.description: Windows Server · New

item.title: [New] Copilot starts using inferences from Microsoft 365 work data for personalised answers; one admin control, enhancedPersonalizationSetting, turns it off
item.description: Copilot · New

item.title: [New] Viva Glint survey mail will come from the tenant's default domain from 1 January 2027 unless a custom sending domain is configured
item.description: Viva · New · deadline 2027-01-01

item.title: [New] Zendesk connections in Microsoft API Hub move to expiring tokens: 48-hour access tokens, 90-day refresh tokens, and existing connections must be reauthorised
item.description: Power Platform · New

item.title: [New] Copilot URL redirect: the remaining users move to copilot.cloud.microsoft in early November, a month later than Microsoft last wrote
item.description: Copilot · New

item.title: [New] New Copilot Pages and Notebooks will be stored in OneDrive from mid-October, two months later than first announced; DLP, retention and eDiscovery for OneDrive then apply
item.description: Copilot · New

item.title: [New] Windows 11 26H2 security baseline is reissued as v2: Administrator protection is now part of it, with credential prompts on the secure desktop
item.description: Windows · New

item.title: [New] A Purview DLP policy can now keep Microsoft 365 Copilot from grounding answers in mail received from external senders
item.description: Purview · New

item.title: [New] Purview DLP can stop Copilot from using external web search for a prompt that contains sensitive information types
item.description: Purview · New

item.title: [New] Sending from aliases is generally available in Exchange Online: a user can send as any proxy address on the mailbox once the tenant switch is on
item.description: Exchange Online · New
